payload.subject: Wave 069 qwen-general runtime timeout bounded diagnosis

incident.bounded_diagnosis: qwen-general returned an explicit gateway timeout at its gateway-to-Ollama 300-second inactivity boundary; vtext did not exhaust its own 900-second HTTP wait budget

concurrent_job.interpretation: single-worker FIFO accepted both jobs, but queue wait plus upstream execution produced approximately 524.8 seconds total latency

retry_evidence.interpretation: same-sized retry success bounds the incident to upstream runtime latency near the 300-second limit; it does not make the canary clean

timeout_layers.ollama: runtime execution details are vision-owned and unavailable on the vtext host
timeout_layers.explanation: the gateway returned HTTP 504 before the vtext wait budget expired; increasing the vtext timeout cannot extend the gateway limit

concurrency_decision.functional_support: two concurrent CLI submissions are admitted and strictly serialized with llm_workers=1
concurrency_decision.production_compatibility: not clean for this workload because execution times of 247.3 to 300.4 seconds leave insufficient gateway headroom and queue latency is cumulative
concurrency_decision.worker_change: keep llm_workers=1 until vision supplies capacity evidence; additional workers may increase shared GPU contention or model churn
concurrency_decision.queue_behavior: queue capacity is 16; no 429 or queue loss occurred in this incident

current_health.vtext: HTTP 200; ASR and LLM queues empty; busy workers zero
current_health.loaded_model_observation: qwen3.5:9b was loaded at the post-incident read-only check; this is not event-time proof

required_evidence: gateway receive, connect, pool, read, write, and completion timestamps plus the exact timed-out operation
qwen3.6 model load, residency, eviction, or swap events
concurrent gateway and Ollama requests during the exact and surrounding windows
prompt-eval and generation token counts and durations, termination reason, GPU pressure, OOM, and Ollama runtime errors

remediation: Do not restart or change current production configuration while vision evidence is pending
Do not raise the 900-second vtext timeout as a response to a gateway-owned 300-second limit
Keep one LLM worker until vision confirms safe shared-runtime concurrency
After vision evidence, choose a shared bounded chunk or output profile only if it provides measured latency headroom
Keep runtime_timeout retryable but classify any canary requiring retry as degraded

bounded_acceptance_test.prerequisite: vision incident evidence received and explicit operator approval; do not rerun Wave 069
bounded_acceptance_test.shape: two fixed representative vBook lessons with the scheduler otherwise paused, routed only through 192.168.0.122:8000, current qwen3.6 profile, and 6000-character vBook chunks
bounded_acceptance_test.clean_pass: every correction and structure call succeeds on its first attempt; manifests are done with errors=[]; no fallback, 429, 5xx, direct GPU access, or residual queue work; each upstream execution is below 270 seconds
bounded_acceptance_test.degraded: any upstream execution is at least 270 but below 300 seconds, or any automatic retry is needed even if final artifacts succeed
bounded_acceptance_test.fail: any execution reaches 300 seconds, any timeout/5xx occurs, artifacts are invalid, or queue behavior is not explained by single-worker FIFO

required_client_actions: Publish this bounded diagnosis and the exact vision evidence request through vsync
Keep the vBook scheduler paused and do not rerun Wave 069
Reply with vision's durable message path and findings before requesting a bounded two-job canary
